coverage: The whole sheet was inspected once for layout; half a and half b were each inspected once line by line against C and H. Read all printed letterhead letters/rule, top SGA reference, every main-a word/formula and four reference additions, nested leaders and four a cancellations, all b prose/family/limit symbols and its circled label, accented initial of Âlors, complete display, En déduire instruction, the complete right corollary with both ovals/loop/cancellations/lower curve/two dots, both dividers and right-end turns, middle pencil note and final pencil correction. Also inspected all margins, the otherwise blank lower half and archival 23. Eleven unique enlarged crops were made and each was viewed once for the listed unsettled loci. No source region remains unviewed; the explicit unresolved readings concern visible but obscured or ambiguous ink, not omitted inspection. No other page, reader, source note, OCR, external research or mathematical reconstruction was used.
